payload.title: Clean up go-doterr in one pass
payload.description: Clean up go-doterr in one pass: land the pending changes, add a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md that protects doterr.go's interface, and make cmd/sync-doterr a separately versioned part of the package.
payload.context: go-doterr is a dependency of Endless, and Mike wants all go-doterr changes in one task. doterr.go is copied into other packages rather than imported, so its interface must stay backward compatible (see README). (1) Pending changes since Jan-Feb 2026: doterr.go and test/doterr.go change entry.Error() from meta.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(...)) to _, _ = fmt.Fprintf(&meta, ...), a lint fix with identical output. Mike did not want it but accepts it rather than fight future lint fixes. cmd/sync-doterr bumps go-dt to v0.5.0 and follows its renames (ErrFileNotExists->ErrFileNotExist, ErrDirDoesNotExist->ErrDirNotExist). (2) Add CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md: agents must not modify doterr.go unless the user asks (they may suggest changes), and any change must be backward compatible. (3) Package sync-doterr as a tool in this repo, versioned separately from doterr itself (Mike leans yes on separate versioning, e.g. its own module tags).

fields.context: doterr.go is meant to be copied into other packages rather than imported (see README), so its interface must stay backward compatible, and changes to it should be rare and deliberate. Three pieces of pending work belong together. (1) Uncommitted changes from Jan-Feb 2026: doterr.go and test/doterr.go change entry.Error() from meta.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(...)) to _, _ = fmt.Fprintf(&meta, ...), a lint fix with identical output. The maintainer accepts it rather than fight future lint fixes. cmd/sync-doterr bumps go-dt to v0.5.0 and follows its renames (ErrFileNotExists->ErrFileNotExist, ErrDirDoesNotExist->ErrDirNotExist). (2) Add a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md telling agents not to modify doterr.go unless the user asks (they may suggest changes), and that any change must be backward compatible. (3) Make cmd/sync-doterr a proper tool in this repo, versioned separately from doterr.go, e.g. with its own module tags.

payload.title: Raise go.mod files to Go 1.27 via gomion repo setup
payload.description: Raise every go.mod in go-doterr to Go 1.27 by running gomion repo setup once the in-flight go.mod/go.sum changes are committed
payload.context:
Gomion task E-2454 is adding `gomion repo setup`, which (among other steps) raises every module's `go` directive to Go 1.27 and tidies. Go 1.27 is now the minimum for Mike's go-pkgs repos because json/v2 no longer needs GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2 there. Generated CI pins Go 1.27 and no longer sets GOEXPERIMENT.

When E-2454 ran, go-doterr's working tree held uncommitted changes from this project's own in-flight work in: cmd/sync-doterr/go.mod, cmd/sync-doterr/go.sum. On 2026-10-28 Mike chose to let this project's own tasks handle their own changes rather than have E-2454 commit around them. So E-2454 committed only the regenerated .github/workflows files here and left every go.mod in go-doterr alone. `gomion repo setup --check` reports go-doterr's modules as below Go 1.27 until this task runs.
